what: The stacked hero photos fade to the next one every 5.5s over 1.5s. The new photo turns on over the old one (the old one stays underneath until the new one is fully on), the active photo slowly zooms in to 1.05× over 5.5s ease-out, and the deactivated photo returns to its normal size after the fade ends (1.5s later)

options.zoom: Scale of the active section, default 1.05
options.[data-fx-part=slide]·[data-fx-part=media: Photo panel · image zooming in inside it
options.fx:next·fx:prev: Fire this event on an element to jump straight to the next or previous section
options.look: On out the old section also turns off together, a crossfade (Swiper crossFade), and the photos of the active and just-deactivated sections recede straight from zoom× to 1 over zoom-dur
options.zoom-dur: Length in seconds of the pull-back in look: out, default 9 · length in seconds of the approach in look: in, default 19
options.look: pan: The old section also fades out in a slick fade crossfade, and the photo in the new section drifts sideways linearly by pan during pan-dur — the fading section keeps drifting until the fade ends, then returns to its place
options.pan: look: with pan, the flow distance (% of photo width), default -8% — negative means leftward
options.pan-dur: Flow duration (s) for look: pan, default 15
options.pan-width: look: photo width in pan, relative to the panel width, default 110% — leaves the flowing part outside the panel
options.pan-from: look: pan — where the flow starts (% of photo width or px), default 0 — one site flows from -35px to 0 (to the right)
options.look: in: A crossfade where the old panel also fades out, and the photo of the lit panel approaches up to zoom times over zoom-dur with ease (longer than the beat, so it moves on before arriving) — the fading panel keeps the size it reached during the fade (project phone Hero 19s · 1.1x)
options.look: breathe: The previous section fades out with a crossfade, and the photos, regardless of section, all breathe 1 → zoom → 1 over zoom-dur (default 32) seconds with ease-in-out — every: 3; fade: 1; zoom: 1.08 matches the tempo of the original 16s four-slide keyframe fade
options.curve: look: in fade and approach curves, look: out fade curve (CSS curves), default ease — brand is linear (fade 2s · approach 7.5s, both straight), brand is cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1) (look: out 8.5s fade)
options.first: With fade, the first slide also turns on from transparent over the fade length (style is measured once right after attaching, then turned on) — even when entering via a barba transition, the first slide fades (Brand TopSlider first show_)
options.zoom-curve: look: curve for retreating on out (CSS curve), default linear — Brand uses ease-in-out (1.15 → 1, 9.5s)
options.beat: Total beat of a section change (seconds) — if given, slides advance at this interval instead of every + fade. For cases where the fade is longer than the beat so the fading-out and fading-in sections overlap (brand 6.5s beat · 8.5s fade)

note: The original layered a Swiper 8 fade (crossFade: false, speed 1500, autoplay 5500, waitForTransition) with a CSS zoom (5.5s 1.5s ease-out). This gives the same beat without Swiper. To pin it to the screen, set the layer to position: fixed.
